description: Defines the autograd Node class and related structures for PyTorch's automatic differentiation system, including graph connectivity, hooks, and metadata management.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Abstract class representing a node in the autograd computation graph, managing inputs, outputs, hooks, and execution metadata.

classes.name: NodeGuard
classes.description: Guard class for managing the evaluation state of a Node during autograd operations.

classes.name: TraceableFunction
classes.description: Derived class indicating a traceable autograd node.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Evaluates the autograd node with given inputs, managing context and hooks.

methods.name: add_input_metadata
methods.description: Adds metadata for a new input tensor, shape, or undefined input.

methods.name: num_inputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs.

methods.name: input_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific input.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Determines the device stream associated with the node's inputs.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device on which the node's inputs are located.

methods.name: update_topological_nr
methods.description: Updates the topological order number based on an edge.

methods.name: set_next_edge
methods.description: Sets a specific next edge for the node.

methods.name: add_next_edge
methods.description: Adds a new next edge to the node.

methods.name: set_next_edges
methods.description: Sets multiple next edges at once.

methods.name: next_edge
methods.description: Retrieves a specific next edge.

methods.name: next_edges
methods.description: Returns all next edges.

methods.name: num_outputs
methods.description: Returns the number of output edges.

methods.name: sequence_nr
methods.description: Gets the sequence number for autograd ordering and profiling.

methods.name: set_sequence_nr
methods.description: Sets the sequence number.

methods.name: topological_nr
methods.description: Returns the topological order number for DAG traversal.

methods.name: assign_parent
methods.description: Assigns a parent node for topological ordering.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the node type.

methods.name: should_compute_output
methods.description: Checks if a specific output edge should be computed.

methods.name: task_should_compute_output
methods.description: Checks if a specific output edge should be computed in the current graph task.

methods.name: pyobj
methods.description: Gets the associated Python object.

methods.name: set_pyobj
methods.description: Sets the associated Python object.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates anomaly metadata.

methods.name: add_post_hook
methods.description: Adds a post-execution hook.

methods.name: del_post_hook
methods.description: Removes a post hook by key.

methods.name: add_pre_hook
methods.description: Adds a pre-execution hook.

methods.name: add_tensor_pre_hook
methods.description: Adds a tensor pre-hook.

methods.name: add_retains_grad_hook
methods.description: Adds a retains_grad hook for a specific output.

methods.name: pop_retains_grad_hook
methods.description: Removes and returns a retains_grad hook.

methods.name: release_variables
methods.description: Releases saved variables, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: will_release_variables
methods.description: Hook called before releasing variables.

methods.name: is_traceable
methods.description: Indicates if the node is traceable.

methods.name: passes_state_transparently
methods.description: Indicates if the node passes state transparently to backward.

methods.name: compiled_args
methods.description: Collects node attributes for compiled autograd.

methods.name: apply_with_saved
methods.description: Applies the node with saved variables.

methods.name: is_aot_backward
methods.description: Checks if the node is an AOTBackward node produced by torch.compile.

methods.name: traced_apply
methods.description: Applies the node with tracing instrumentation.
